kind: independent actual-source review and two narrow owned local controls

findings.severity: blocker for complete FD-error cleanup qualification
findings.evidence: Actual AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET socketpair, SO_PASSPIDFD, actual candidate Receive/Rights. Ordinary receiver adopted 2 SCM_RIGHTS and closed both (delta 0). PASSPIDFD receiver returned EPROTO 71 and closed the two SCM_RIGHTS, but left one anon_inode:[pidfd] installed. Control closed only the new leaked FD, all control descriptors restored.
findings.limitation: No actual inherited listening socket or Pocket4 service. First local listener attempt failed socket(AF_UNIX) with EPERM before service/Receive; preserved separately. ValidateSocket nonlistener accepts PASSPIDFD; listener validation source contains no PASSPIDFD exclusion.
findings.fix_direction: In a new revision, adopt/close known FD-bearing SCM_PIDFD on rejection or enforce and verify a complete socket-option invariant before receive; protocol error alone does not close the descriptor.

findings.severity: blocker for preserving original child failure evidence
findings.source: controller.py Child.join local outputs/open_fds and finish -> retire -> join
findings.evidence: Actual spawn/Child, one own bounded child wrote 65,537 bytes. First join raised RuntimeError owned child output exceeded bound. retire then reaped exit 0 but reported empty stdout, retained zero consumed bytes. All owned descriptors restored and child reaped.
findings.fix_direction: Keep bounded output buffers, pipe-open state and first errors on Child across join/retire; do not reread or reclose invalidated numeric pipe slots. Attach cleanup errors without replacing primary failure.

review_conclusions: Exact factory input/output descriptor holders use RAII and close SCM_RIGHTS on malformed/truncated protocol paths, apart from confirmed F1.
